spans.s: नंग m. A lover, a paramour.
ननंदृ f. A husband’s sister, ननांदुः पत्या च देव्याः संदिष्टमृष्यशृंगेण Ut.i.
ननंदृ f. A husband’s sister, ननांदुः पत्या च देव्याः संदिष्टमृष्यशृंगेण Ut.i.
ननांदृपति m. the husband of a husband’s sister.
ननांदृपति m. the husband of a husband’s sister.

ननु ind. A particle- (1) of interrogation, ननु समाप्तकृत्यो गौतमः Ut.iv.; (2) of ironical interrogation (‘certainly, surely’), यदा मेधाविनी शिष्योपदेशं मलिनयति तदाचार्यस्य दोषो ननु Mal.i.; (3) of certainty, उपपन्नं ननु शिवं सप्तस्वंगेषु यस्य मे R.i.60; (4) of persuasion or supplication (‘please,’ ‘pray’) ननु मां प्रापय पत्युरंतिकम् K.S.iv.32; (5) it is used as a corrective particle (‘why’) ननु भवानग्रतो मे वर्तते Sak.ii.; (6) as a vocative particle, ननु मूर्खाः पठितमेव युष्माभिस्तत्कांडे Ut.iv.; (7) as a particle introducing an objection or a contrary proposition in argumentative language), e.g. ननु क्वचिदसत्वमपि प्रागुत्पत्तेः कार्यस्य व्यपदिशति श्रुतिः S.Bh.

नंद m. 1. Happiness, pleasure, joy; 2. a kind of lute; 3. a frog; 4. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 5. name of a cowherd who was the foster-father of Kṛṣṇa; 6. name of nine brother-kings of Pāṭalīputra murdered by the machinations of Cāṇakya, समुत्खाता नंदा नव हृदयरोगा इव भुवः Mud.i.
नंदा f. 1. Delight, joy; 2. wealth, prosperity; 3. a small earthen water-jar; 4. a husband’s sister; 5. the first, sixth and eleventh day of a lunar fortnight.
नंद-आत्मज, -नंदन m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
नंद-आत्मज, -नंदन m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
नंद-पाल m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
नंदक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Rejoicing, gladdening; 2. delighting in; 3. gladdening a family.
नंदक (II) m. 1. A frog; 2. name of the sword of Viṣṇu; 3. a sword in general.
नंदक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Rejoicing, gladdening; 2. delighting in; 3. gladdening a family.
नंदकिन् m. An epithet of Viṣṇu.
नंदथु m. Happiness, pleasure.
नंदन (I) a. (f. ना) Delighting, gladdening.
नंदन (II) m. 1. A son, R.iii.41; 2. a frog; 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 4. of Śiva.
नंदन (III) n. 1. Name of the garden of Indra, अभिज्ञाश्छेदपातानां क्रियंते नंदनद्रुमाः K.S.ii.41; 2. rejoicing, being glad, joy.
नंदन (I) a. (f. ना) Delighting, gladdening.
नंदन-ज n. yellow sandal-wood (हरिचंदन).
नंदंत m. A son.
नंदंत m. A son.
नंदि (I) m.f. Joy, pleasure, e.g. कौशल्यानंदिवर्धनो रामः.
नंदि (II) m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Śiva; 3. name of an attendant of Śiva.

नांदी f. 1. Joy, satisfaction; 2. prosperity; 3. praise of a deity at the commencement of any religious ceremony; 4. a benedictory verse or verses at the opening of a drama. (नांदी is thus defined- आशीर्वचनसंयुक्ता नित्यं यस्मात्प्रयुज्यते । देवद्विजनृपादीनां तस्मान्नांदीति कीर्तिता.)
नंदि-ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. name of one of the chief attendants of Śiva.
नंदि-ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. name of one of the chief attendants of Śiva.
नंदि-ग्राम m. name of a village where Bharata resided during Rāma’s banishment.
नंदि-घोष m. name of the chariot of Arjuna.
नंदि-वर्धन m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. a friend; 3. the end of a lunar fortnight.
नंदिक m. 1. Joy, pleasure; 2. a small water-jar; 3. an attendant of Śiva.
नंदिक-ईश, -ईश्वर m. name of one of Śiva’s chief attendants.
नंदिक-ईश, -ईश्वर m. name of one of Śiva’s chief attendants.
नंदिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Happy, delighted; 2. making happy, gladdening.
नंदिन् (II) m. 1. A son; 2. the speaker of a prelude or benediction in a drama; 3. name of the door-keeper of Śiva, लतागृहद्वारगतोऽथ नंदी K.S.iii.41.
नांदिकर m. The speaker of the benediction before the commencement of a play.
नंदिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Happy, delighted; 2. making happy, gladdening.

नंदिनी f. 1. A daughter; 2. a husband’s sister; 3. a fabulous cow, daughter of Surabhi, granting all desires, owned by Vasiṣṭha, अनिंद्या नंदिनी नाम धेनुराववृते वनात् R.i.82, ii.69; 4. an epithet of the Ganges.

नाना ind. 1. In different places, manifoldly, variously; 2. distinctly, separately; 3. without, (with an acc., inst. or abl.), e.g. नाना नारीं निष्फला लोकयात्रा, or न नाना शंभुना रामात्; 4. (when used as an adjective in the beginning of a compound) various, sundry, different, diverse, नानादिगंतवास्तव्यो महाजनसमाजः M.M.i., Bg.i.9, M.ix.148.
नाना-अत्यय a. of different kinds, manifold.
नाना-अर्थ f. 1. having different aims or objects; 2. having different meanings.
नाना-कारम् ind. having done variously.
नाना-रूप a. of different forms, multiform, various, M.ix.38.
नाना-वर्ण a. of different colours.
नाना-विध a. of various sorts.
नाना-विधम् ind. in various ways.
नानांद्र m. A husband’s sister’s son.
नांत a. (f. ता) Endless.
नांत a. (f. ता) Endless.
नांतरीयक a. (f. का) Inseparable, invariably connected.
नांतरीयक a. (f. का) Inseparable, invariably connected.
नांत्र n. Praise, eulogy.
नांदिकर m. The speaker of the benediction before the commencement of a play.
नांदी-कर m. the same as नांदिन् q.v.
नांदी-निनाद m. a shout of joy.
नांदी-पट m. the lid or cover of a well.
नांदी-मुख (I) a. (the class of manes of deceased progenitors) to whom the Nāndīmukha Srāddha is offered.
नांदी-मुख (II) n. a Śrāddha to the manes, preliminary to any joyous occasion.
नांदी-मुख (III) m. the cover of a well.
नांदी-वादिन् m. 1. the speaker of the prologue to a drama; 2. a drummer.
नांदी-श्राद्ध n. See नांदीमुख II.
